name: Header guard
meaning: Preprocessor conditionals that avoid repeated processing of a header in one translation unit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Internal linkage
meaning: A name designating an entity only within its translation unit.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Macro expansion
meaning: Token substitution performed by the preprocessor, not an ordinary function call.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Conditional compilation
meaning: Including or excluding source text using preprocessing conditions.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Generic selection
meaning: Compile-time selection of an expression according to a controlling expression’s type.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Stream ownership
meaning: Responsibility for checking acquisition and closing a FILE stream exactly once.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: EOF sentinel
meaning: An int result indicating no next character, with stream indicators distinguishing end-of-file from error.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Byte order
meaning: The specified order of octets representing a multi-octet value.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: errno
meaning: A library error indicator meaningful only according to the called operation’s documented contract.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Cleanup path
meaning: A control-flow route that releases already-acquired resources before returning a status.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Assertion
meaning: A build-removable check of an internal expectation, not a substitute for input validation.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Regression test
meaning: A repeatable check protecting previously expected behavior against later changes.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Sanitizer
meaning: Runtime instrumentation that detects certain errors on exercised paths, without proving all paths safe.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Object file
meaning: Compiled output for a translation unit that still may need other definitions at link time.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Argument vector
meaning: The array of command-line string pointers supplied to hosted main, followed by a null pointer.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Thread join
meaning: Waiting for a thread to terminate and establishing synchronization before later observation.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Mutex
meaning: A mutual-exclusion object coordinating access to shared state.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Sequential consistency
meaning: The default atomic ordering that includes one total order of sequentially consistent atomic operations.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Volatile qualification
meaning: A qualifier affecting accesses, without providing thread synchronization or atomic read-modify-write.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.

name: Capacity invariant
meaning: A rule keeping the count of occupied entries within the allocated storage bound.
context: C language/library semantics; portable C17 core.
